label: INFO-ONLY, LOWER-ONLY. Stick Echo checks that the on-screen movement of the player being controlled follows the logged left stick. It never raises a status and never makes the call; a clear disagreement can only suggest lowering VERIFIED to PARTIAL. It does not show who held the controller.
built_during: Meta AI Developer Hackathon, Oct 26 - Nov 4 2026 (built Oct 28 2026)
sam_role: Meta SAM 3.1 tracks the controlled player (box prompt seeded on the game's controlled-player marker, forward propagation). Marker detection, camera compensation, frame selection, the lag and the scoring are deterministic code.

clock.rule: stick sample at frame time minus the lag (input clock); lag fixed before scoring

not_published: frames, crops, per-frame boxes and velocities, per-window values, raw controller timeline

diagnostics.note: lag sweep is a diagnostic only; it never sets the lag

summary: controller and video agree: 514 frames in 6 window(s), mean cosine 786/1000, min z 4.45 over 3 null source(s); method hybrid (exploratory).
